one_liner: SendGrid has a broad REST v3 API with API-key Bearer auth; only a 60-day free trial (no free plan), and only community MCP servers exist.
auth_notes: Bearer API keys created in the console; Basic auth is no longer accepted. No OAuth documented.
access_notes: New accounts get a 60-day trial, 100 emails/day, no credit card required. After that a paid plan is needed (Essentials from about $19.95/mo).
blocker_notes: A 60-day trial is long enough to build and test. Customers use their own API keys.

evidence.quote: To use an API key, include an `Authorization` header with the value `Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>` in your request.
Basic Authentication is no longer accepted; you must use an API key.
